name.zh: 史黛菈蓄力与一辉赛前调整
name.en: Stella conserves strength while Ikki tunes himself for the final

periods.location: Osaka hotel and League training facility near Bay Dome
periods.summary: Stella sleeps deeply after eating heavily, conserving every bit of dragon power for the final while Kurono and Nene watch and prepare to intervene if the lovers' duel becomes lethal. Elsewhere, Ikki admits to Shizuku and Alice that he fears the fully awakened Stella, then insists that continuous sparring is the only way to reach his best condition.
periods.cause: Both finalists recognize that the final may decide not only the title but whether Ikki can stand beside Stella's awakened dragon power.
periods.outcome: Stella awakens at dusk in unprecedented condition; Ikki begins a chain of training matches to stop himself from freezing under fear.
periods.significance: Contrasts Stella's absolute-power preparation with Ikki's fear-driven refinement and sets up the final's life-threatening stakes.
